judged_text: When the parsed data lacks refresh_token, the code assigns the literal string "refresh_token" as the refresh token (`refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`). Google Calendar, Office365 and Zoom persist the literal string "refresh_token" into prisma.credential, permanently destroying the user's real refresh token; the next access-token expiry makes the integration unrecoverable without re-auth.
